description: Micro-account $5 -> $1000 compound challenge. Focuses on V75, V50, and Step Index (lowest min lot sizes). Aggressive Half-Kelly compounding on high-conviction setups only.

micro_account_notes.reason: Only these 3 symbols have min lot sizes small enough for $5. V75 min=0.001, V50 min=0.001, Step min=0.10. Other instruments require minimum lots that would risk >100% of account.
micro_account_notes.scaling_plan: As balance grows past $50, unlock Crash 300 + Boom 300. Past $200, unlock all 14 instruments.

trade_holding._notes: Runner trades keep the broker TP at TP2, bank runner_close_fraction at TP1, then trail best price - trail_atr_mult x ATR(14). max_hold_hours 0 = unlimited. For multi-day holds use timeframe H1. Each new candle the entry thesis is re-checked: broken -> exit, intact -> keep holding and push the runner target out. Pyramiding adds a position only when every existing leg has its stop locked in profit; adds count toward max_open_trades.

calibration._notes: After each closed trade the bot compares the win probability it claimed with the result, per strategy, and scales future claims (shrunk toward 1.0 by 20 pseudo-trades).
